decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet builds closely on the firm's established formulation know-how and Rx portfolio, so the firm can interpret early results and refine the product, which favours keeping it.

The generic antidepressant capsule is distant from the core offer, which limits the firm's ability to learn from it, but it has its own page, is newly launched and benefits from existing manufacturing and regulatory capabilities, so it is kept for now.
The combination antihypertensive matches the firm's competence in improved combination formulations and adherence, giving it strong absorptive capacity to sustain and improve this product.

The supplement fits the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive self-care products and builds on the existing offer, though its weaker web presence and the competitive supplement market add some risk of being dropped.
